entries.en_old: Welcome home! A welcome gift is waiting in your 📬 Mailbox.
entries.en_new: Welcome to your homestead! A gift awaits in your Mailbox.

entries.en_old: Welcome to your Homestead! This land is yours to build. Make 💰 Money by selling your goods to 🤠 Kent.
entries.en_new: Welcome to your Homestead! This land is yours to build. Make Money by selling your goods to Kent.

entries.en_old: Your crops are growing. Come back when they are ready, and keep an eye on the Signpost: the Train pays well for your goods.
entries.en_new: Well done! You're on your own now. Keep planting, harvesting, and selling goods to Kent. And be sure to explore more of the Town.

entries.en_old: You have been returned home. Any backpack 🎒 items you had were lost.
entries.en_new: You wake in Town. Any backpack 🎒 items you had were lost.

entries.en_old: Use the A-W-S-D keys, the arrow keys, or click a tile to MOVE. Click to interact with things within your interaction radius.
entries.en_new: Use the A-W-S-D keys, the arrow keys, or click a tile to MOVE. Walk over an item to pick it up. Click to interact with things within your interaction radius.

entries.en_old: Tap a tile to MOVE. Tap to interact with things within your interaction radius.

entries.en_old: Your Town, the Valley and the dungeons are yours to explore, at your own pace. Other players are your neighbours: their Homesteads share your SETTLEMENT, and you play together through the CARAVAN, the HARVEST FAIR, the TRADING POST, elections for MAYOR, chat and the leaderboards.
entries.en_new: Your Town, the Valley and the dungeons are yours to explore, at your own pace. Other players are your neighbours: their Homesteads share your Settlement, and you play together through trading, chat and the leaderboards.

entries.en_old: Explore {icon:icon-farming.svg} FARMING, {icon:icon-build.svg} BUILD, and {icon:icon-buy.svg} BUY to improve your Homestead and generate resources.
entries.en_new: Explore {icon:icon-farming.svg} Farming, {icon:icon-build.svg} Build, and {icon:icon-buy.svg} Buy to improve your Homestead and generate resources.

entries.en_old: Generate {res:Money} GOLD from {res:Kent} KENT or at the {res:Trading Post} TRADING POST.
entries.en_new: Generate {res:Money} Gold from {res:Kent} Kent or at the {res:Trading Post} Trading Post.

entries.en_old: As you create wealth, improve yourself with SKILLS and ABILITIES. For example, purchase the BACKPACK SKILL to collect items from the Valley.
entries.en_new: As you create wealth, improve yourself with Skills and Abilities. For example, purchase the Backpack Skill to collect items from the Valley.

entries.en_old: Walk off the edge of the map, or into a signpost, to travel. Zoom out (- and +) to see how big the world is. Your Homestead is one of many in a SETTLEMENT, which shares a TOWN. Your Settlement is one of many in the FRONTIER.
entries.en_new: Walk off the edge of the map, or into a signpost, to travel. Zoom out (- and +) to see how big the world is. Your Homestead is one of many in a Settlement, which shares a Town. Your Settlement is one of many in the Frontier.

entries.en_old: When you are ready, explore the VALLEY and its dungeons, full of danger and wonders. Click an enemy within reach to attack it (or press Space). The secrets of the wizard PROSPERO and the lost king LEONTES , among others, are hidden there.
entries.en_new: When you are ready, explore the Valley and its dungeons, full of danger and wonders. Click an enemy within reach to attack it (or press Space). The secrets of the wizard Prospero and the lost king Leontes , among others, are hidden there. Pursue the Quest for Hope at the Oracle.

entries.en_old: Set your own goals. At the end of each {icon:icon-season.svg} SEASON, which runs three months, players and settlements are ranked, and the top places earn extra rewards. Your Homestead, skills and inventory carry over into the next Season.

entries.en_old: I was stone so long, {username}, I almost forgot the feel of the sun. One woe doth tread upon another's heel: the storm, my crown, my King. Helena's song woke me; my husband did not come. Mark that. Come and see my garden. It is the only thing in this castle that stayed alive. Bake me Queen's Cake, and I'll pay thee in diamonds; that thief Iago would give a fortune for a ring.
entries.en_new: I was stone so long, {username}, I almost forgot the feel of the sun. One woe doth tread upon another's heel: the storm, my crown, my King. Helena's song woke me; my husband did not come. Mark that. Now look at me: a queen in last winter's gown! Bring me cakes, bring me coffees, bring me dresses fit for a crown, and be quick about it. I pay in diamonds; sell them to that thief Iago if thou must. I have rings enough.

entries.en_old: 'Tis time. Be stone no more! I was cold so long, {username}, and now I breathe. The storm took my crown, my king and my garden, but not my heart. Thank sweet Helena, and thank that singing fool. And remember this: if Prospero's spell can break once, it can break again. Bake me Queen's Cake, and I'll pay thee in diamonds; that thief Iago would give a fortune for a ring.
